summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare-IP over unverified TLS
details: At npm install time, the package's postinstall hook resolves an optional platform binary by fetching a tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz) rather than a publisher-controlled domain. The HTTPS request sets rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling certificate validation, and no hash or signature is verified against the downloaded bytes. The tarball is extracted, the contained binary is chmod'd 0o755, and it is linked as bin/.onecode so that subsequent invocations execute it. The default download base can be overridden via ONECODE_TGZ_DOWNLOAD_BASE, but the hardcoded default is a bare IPv4 host on a non-standard port with no association to the @onescience publisher. Any party controlling that IP, or an on-path attacker between the installer and that host, can substitute arbitrary code that runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
